title: APPEAL OF DAMON TYJUAN BROUSSARD CONCERNING THE
text:
[EXECUTIVE SESSION]
APPEAL OF DAMON TYJUAN BROUSSARD CONCERNING THE
  DEPARTMENT’S SEPTEMBER 15, 2026, DECISION TO DENY HIS MOTOR
  BUS DRIVER PERMIT APPLICATION, PURSUANT TO BOARD ORDER 600,
  RULE D(1) – PERMANENT DISQUALIFICATION
summary: Executive-session appeal by a bus driver permit applicant of the department's September 15, 2026 decision to deny a motor bus driver permit application under the permanent disqualification rule in Board Order 600.
